definitions.explanation: A number expressed as a ratio of two integers (numerator over denominator).

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}で{分数|ぶんすう}を{習|なら}った。
examples.english: I learned fractions in elementary school.

examples.japanese: {分数|ぶんすう}の{足|た}し{算|ざん}は{通分|つうぶん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Adding fractions requires finding a common denominator.

examples.japanese: {二分|にぶん}の{一|いち}は{分数|ぶんすう}で{表|あらわ}すと1/2だ。
examples.english: One half is expressed as 1/2 as a fraction.

notes:
COMPONENTS:
・{分子|ぶんし} - numerator (top number)
・{分母|ぶんぼ} - denominator (bottom number)

TYPES:
・{真分数|しんぶんすう} - proper fraction (numerator < denominator)
・{仮分数|かぶんすuu} - improper fraction (numerator ≥ denominator)
・{帯分数|たいぶんすう} - mixed number

OPERATIONS:
・{通分|つうぶん} - finding common denominator
・{約分|やくぶん} - reducing/simplifying fractions

RELATED MATH TERMS:
・{整数|せいすう} - integer
・{小数|しょうすう} - decimal
・{百分率|ひゃくぶんりつ} - percentage
